title: helm(private): values schema + init hooks + tolerations/nodeAffinity + upgrade/rollback stability
author: Maya Patel
description: Summary: Harden private Helm chart values/schema and init hooks to improve install/upgrade/rollback stability for VPC/on-prem deployments. Motivation: customers running Private in air-gapped and strict-node-affinity environments hit failures during upgrades (missing init jobs, unset tolerations or incompatible encryption settings). This PR: 1) expands charts/private/values.schema.json with explicit encryption/kms, storage and nodeAffinity/tolerations validation rules to fail-fast on invalid configs; 2) templates tolerations/nodeAffinity into the statefulset and init jobs consistently via _helpers.tpl; 3) introduce a pre-install init-secrets Job (hook: pre-install, pre-upgrade) that validates/creates KMS envelope keys and migrates legacy S3 envelope metadata when present; 4) add a rollback CRD-cleanup job (hook: pre-rollback) that ensures CRD-backed resources are safe to re-apply during rollback; 5) small docs/README updates and examples for common Private deployment footguns; 6) compatibility logic: new schema is backwards compatible, migration job runs only when legacy flags are detected. See linked Linear items ENG-4218 and ENG-4301 for acceptance criteria. Checklist: - [x] values.schema updates and unit tests - [x] helm template tests (render) - [x] integration: install/upgrade/rollback in kind/k3s - [x] docs and examples updated - [x] reviewers addressed comments CI matrix: build/lint/helm-lint/helm-template/unit-tests/integration-helm-upgrade/e2e-private-install. Notes: this PR intentionally keeps runtime container images and chart API unchanged (no breaking changes) but adds a validation layer to catch misconfigurations earlier. If encryption.kms.keyId is changed, the pre-install init job will attempt a metadata migration; see release_notes for operator guidance.
commits: feat(helm): values.schema.json - add encryption/kms/storage and nodeAffinity/tolerations validation
feat(helm): templates - factor tolerations/nodeAffinity into _helpers.tpl and include in statefulsets/init jobs
chore(helm): add hooks/init-secrets-job.yaml (pre-install/pre-upgrade) with migration path for legacy S3 envelope metadata
fix(helm): add pre-rollback hook rollback-crd-cleanup job to avoid stuck CRD resources on rollback
test(helm): add helm unit tests + integration scenario for upgrade/rollback
docs: update charts/private/README.md with migration and troubleshooting guidance
review_comments: Jared Kim: Schema looks thorough — thanks for the detailed validation rules. Can we keep the old encryption.s3.* keys accepted for one release cycle?
Maya Patel: Answered: yes, migration logic accepts legacy s3 envelope metadata and will only run when legacy flags are present. Added unit tests to cover both paths.
Sofia Martinez: The pre-rollback hook is good, but ensure it is idempotent (helm rollback sometimes re-runs hooks). Please add guard annotations.
Maya Patel: Added helm.sh/hook-weight and annotated the job with an idempotency guard (labels + noop when already cleaned).
Anya Gupta: Integration flake observed on k3s where init job timed out (PVC mounting). Suggest increasing hook timeout and improving logs.
Maya Patel: Increased job activeDeadlineSeconds and added additional logging to the init job. Re-ran integration tests locally and in CI.
release_notes: - charts/private: strengthen values schema with encryption/kms/storage validation. - Add pre-install/pre-upgrade init job to validate/migrate encryption metadata. - Add pre-rollback job to cleanup CRD resources to improve rollback stability. - Templating: unified tolerations/nodeAffinity helpers to avoid scheduling errors on upgrade. - No breaking changes: old encryption.s3.* keys are migrated automatically during install/upgrade.
